messages:
riley: Heads-up — cascade auto-fallbacks triggered in prod during the evening spike. Want to iterate on a console flow that makes cause obvious without leaking request data. Quick brainstorm? :mag_right:

ana: (typo: ana) I'd keep the row minimal: status pill, short cause string, est. cost delta, and a single 'Inspect' button. Inspect side-panel shows non-sensitive evidence.

carlos: Evidence should be metric badges + policy snippet + decision confidence. Example badge text: `p95=1.3s | err=4.2% | sample=5%`. No raw text in panel.

riley: Good. For audit store we agreed hashed_prefix (sha256) + token_count + token_type_enum + redaction_flag. Also store decision_reason enum, matched_policy, matched_rule.

ops-bot: alert: fallback_rate("api-payments") > 2.5% over 5m -> page @oncall-sre :rotating_light:

ana: API design idea: single flat GET /v1/fallbacks/decision?id=<id>. Return scalars only: decision_id, ts, reason, policy, rule, p95_ms, err_pct, sample_pct, confidence_pct, org_hash, override_state. Keeps UI queries cheap.

carlos: We should standardize reason enums to: backend_down, latency_tail, quota_pressure, safety_hold, config_error. Makes dashboards simpler.

riley: Operator overrides: two modes — transient (soft) and permanent (hard). Soft default TTL=10m (configurable per team). Soft shows a countdown and operator name; hard requires ticket id and approver. Both create immutable audit lines.

ana: Privacy checkbox: sampled snippets are gated behind data-access role. UI shows 'snippet gated' unless user has permission. Also show `sampled_snippet_allowed` boolean in the decision record.

carlos: Telemetry keys (flat dot-style): fallback.reason, fallback.policy, fallback.rule, fallback.p95_ms, fallback.err_pct, fallback.sample_pct, fallback.confidence, fallback.org_hash, fallback.override_by. These map well to metrics and logs.

riley: Retention proposal: full audit traces 90d, sampled snippets 30d, enterprise tiers configurable. We'll include export CSV for PMs/postmortems.

ana: UX microcopy suggestion for row: "Quiet-degrade — latency_tail (p95 1.3s) — est. cost +9% — Inspect". Side-panel header: "Decision aid-dec-<orghash>-1799954321" (k-anonymized id).

carlos: Small nit: include decision_confidence (0-100) in telemetry but hide it by default in UI; useful for SRE analysis of false positives.

ops-bot: info: deploy/cascade-v5 canary started -> monitoring.

riley: Action items: ana to mock the row + side-panel microcopy, carlos to add telemetry schema to infra-telemetry, I'll draft a short RFC for TTL/retention defaults and the GET endpoint. If no objections I'll open the RFC tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
